702802.full: βραβεύω (βραβεύς, an umpire), [in LXX: Wis.10:12 * ;] __(a) prop., to act as umpire; hence, __(b) generally, to arbitrate, decide (Isocr., Dem.; Lft., Col., l.with; MM, see word): Col.3:15; __(with) in some late writers, to direct, rule, control (so in Col., l.with, accusative to Thayer, see word, Meyer, in l.), (cf. κατα-βραβεύω). † (AS)

702806.lxx: in LXX: Gen.43:10 (מההּ hith.), Deu.7:10, Isa.46:13 (אחר pi.), Si 32 (35):18 *
702806.full: βραδύνω (βραδύς), [in LXX: Gen.43:10 (מההּ hith.), Deu.7:10, Isa.46:13 (אחר pi.), Si 32 (35):18 * ;] __1. trans., to retard (Soph., Is, l.with). __2. More frequently intrans., to be slow, to tarry: 1Ti.3:15, 2Pe.3:9. † (AS)

702808.lxx: in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה
702808.full: βραχίων, -ὀνος, ὁ, [in LXX, β. Κυρίου, frequently for זְרוֹעַ יהוָֹה ;] the arm; as in OT, β. Κυρίου, metaphorically, for the Divine power: Luk.1:51, Jhn.12:38" (LXX), Act.13:17.† (AS)

702809.full: βραχύς, -εῖα, -ύ, [in LXX chiefly for מְעַט ;] short; __(a) of time; short, little: βραχύ, Act.5:34; μετὰ β., Luk.22:58; β. τι, a short time, Heb.2:7, 9 RV, mg.; __(b) of distance: Act.27:28; __(with) of quantity or value, little, few: Jhn.6:7, Heb.2:7, 9 RV, txt.; pl., διὰ βραχέων, in few words, Heb.13:22. † (AS)

702811.full: βρέφος, -ους, τό, [in LXX: Sir.19:11, 1Ma.1:61, 2Ma.6:10, 3Ma.5:49, 4Ma.4:25 * ;] __1. an unborn child: Luk.1:41, 44. __2. a newborn child, a babe: Luk.2:12, 16 18:15, Act.7:19, 1Pe.2:2; ἀπὸ βρέφους, from infancy, 2Ti.3:15. † (AS)

702812.full: βρέχω, [in LXX chiefly for מטר ;] __1. to wet: Luk.7:38, 44. __2. In late Gk. writers and vernac. = ὕειν, to send rain, to rain (Kennedy, Sources, 39, 155): Mat.5:45; trop., β. πῦρ κ. θεῖον, Luk.17:29; impers., βρέχει, it rains: Jas.5:17; with ὐετός as subj., Rev.11:6. † (AS)

702814.full: 1. Lat. fremitus, any loud noise, as the crackling of fire, (Iliad by Homer); roaring of a storm, (Aeschulus Tragicus); neighing of horses, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. rage, fury , (Euripides) (ML)

702815.full: 1. to thunder , (Odyssey by Homer); metaphorically of Pericles, (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. impersonal, βροντᾶι it thunders , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

702819.full: βροχή, -ῆς, ἡ (βρέχω), [in LXX: Psa.67 (68):9, 104 (105):32 (גֶּשֶׁם)* ;] __1. = βροχετός, a wetting (in π., of irrigation in Egypt; Deiss., LAE, 77). __2. As in MGr. (Kennedy, Sources, 153), = ὑετός, rain: Mat.7:25, 27. † (AS)

s: a noose, a slip-knot, a halter
702820.full: βρόχος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: Pro.6:5 (יָד) 7:21 (חֵלֶק) 22:25 (מוֹקֵשׁ), 3Ma.4:8 * ;] a noose, a slip-knot, a halter: metaphorically, a restraint (not, as AV, R, txt., a snare): 1Co.7:35.† (AS)

s: a biting, a gnashing of teeth
702821.full: βρυγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βρύχω), [in LXX: Pro.19:12 (נַהַם), Sir.51:3 * ;] a biting, a gnashing of teeth: Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.† (AS)

702822.full: βρύχω (Attic, βρύκω), [in LXX: Job.16:10(9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, La 2:16 (חרק)* ;] __1. to bite or eat greedily. __2. to gnash, grind, with the teeth: Act.7:54. † (AS)

702823.full: βρῶμα, -τος, τό (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹכֶל ;] food: Rom.14:15, 20 1Co.8:8, 13 10:3; pl., Mat.14:15, Mrk.7:19, Luk.3:11 9:13, 1Co.6:13, 1Ti.4:3, Heb.9:10 13:9; trop., of spiritual food, Jhn.4:34, 1Co.3:2 (cf. βρῶσις).† (AS)

702825.lxx: in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל
702825.full: βρῶσις, -εως, ἡ (cf. βιβρώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל ;] __1. eating: β. καὶ πόσις, Rom.14:17, Col.2:16 (see Lft., ICC, in l.); with genitive obj., 1Co.8:4; metaphorically, corrosion, rust: Mat.6:19, 20. __2. As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, food: Jhn.6:27a, 2Co.9:10, Col.2:16 (EV, but see supr.). Heb.12:16; metaphorically, of spiritual nourishment, Jhn.4:32 6:27b, 55.† (AS)

s: to cause to sink, to sink
702829.full: βυθίζω (βυθός), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:4 * ;] trans., to cause to sink, to sink: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, 1Ti.6:9; pass., to sink, intrans.: Luk.5:7.† (AS)

702830.full: βυθός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX: Exo.15:5, Neh.9:11 (מְצוֹלָה), Psa.67 (68):22 68 (69):2, 15 106 (107):24 (מְצוּלָה)* ;] __1. the bottom. __2. the depth of the sea, the deep sea: 2Co.11:25. † (AS)

702832.full: 1. the skin stripped off, a hide , (Batrachomyomachia); βύρσης ὄζειν to smell of leather , (Aristophanes Comicus): a drum , (Euripides) 2. the skin of a live animal, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

702833.lxx: in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc.
702833.full: βύσσινος, -η, -ον (βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;] made of βύσσος, fine linen: Rev.18:12, 16 19:8, 14.† (AS)

702834.lxx: in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ
702834.full: βύσσος, -οῦ, ἡ (cf. Heb. בּוּץ), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ ;] byssus, a fine species of flax, also the linen made from it: Luk.16:19.† (AS)

702835.full: 1. to stuff , 2. with genitive rei, to stuff full of , only in Pass., νήματος βεβυσμένος stuffed full of spun-work or yarn, (Odyssey by Homer); τὸ στόμα ἐβέβυστο [i.e. χρυσοῦ] (Herdotus Historicus) 3. with dative rei, to stop or bung up with, plug : Pass., σπογγίωι βεβυσμένος (Aristophanes Comicus) 4. absolute, βεβ. τὰ ὦτα deaf , (Lucian) (ML)

702839.full: 1. a lump of earth, a clod , Lat. gleba, (Odyssey by Homer) 2. like Lat. gleba, land, ground, soil, (Moschus Bucolicus) (ML)

702840.lxx: in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה
702840.full: βωμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βαίνω), [in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה ;] __1. any raised place, a platform. __2. an altar: Act.17:23 (cf. θυσιαστήριον and see DB, i, 75). † (AS)

702871.full: Γαβριήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, hero of God), the archangel Gabriel: Luk.1:19, 26.† (AS)

702872.full: Γάδ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גָּד), Gad (Gen.30:11 49:13, al.): Rev.7:5.† (AS)

702884.full: Γάζα -ης, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה), Gaza, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: Act.8:26.† (AS)

702885.lxx: in LXX for גִּנְזִין, II Est.5:17 6:1 7:20, 21, Est.4:7; גִּזְבָּר, II Est.7:21; Isa.39:2 *
702885.full: γάζα, -ης, ἡ (a Persian word), [in LXX for גִּנְזִין, II Est.5:17 6:1 7:20, 21, Est.4:7; גִּזְבָּר, II Est.7:21; Isa.39:2 * ;] treasure: Act.8:27.† (AS)

702896.lxx: in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה (4Ki.23:11, al.), once for גְּנָזִים (Est.3:9); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, Neh.10:37, 2Ma.3:6, al.
702896.full: γαζο-φυλάκιον, -ου, τό (γάζα, φυλακή), [in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה (4Ki.23:11, al.), once for גְּנָזִים (Est.3:9); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, Neh.10:37, 2Ma.3:6, al. ;] treasury: also, apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown (DB, iv, 96; DCG, ii, 748): Mrk.12:41, 43 Luk.21:1, Jhn.8:20.† (AS)
